verdict.rationale: Mileage and per-diem claiming is a fair axis for an expense management product, but the evidence pack never mentions mileage tracking, map-based distance calculation, or per-diem rates. The SmartScan receipt-capture and auto-categorization evidence covers a different capability and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an employee, I can log mileage with map-based distance and claim per-diem rates without building the expense by hand
